data.name: Logix common TUI and editing standard
data.owner: Logix / AION Software; portable CP/M extension developed with DRI

specification.portability_goal: DRI is encouraged and later assumed to distribute the TUI extension for other CP/M computers.

services.name: Layout and screen
services.description: Query usable dimensions, clip and scroll; separate document coordinates from screen coordinates.

services.name: Adaptive layouts
services.description: Compact 40-column and expanded 80-column layouts; dialogs, long names and errors fit either width.

services.name: Semantic colors
services.description: Normal text, selection and warning roles map to color or monochrome attributes.

services.name: Input
services.description: Structured character, function/navigation key and modifier events; blocking input and polling.

services.name: Controls
services.description: Fields, lists, menus, dialogs, popup windows and consistent focus movement.

services.name: Editing
services.description: Common selection, insertion/deletion and clipboard commands.

services.name: Clipboard
services.description: Explicit formats, lengths, bounded capacity, ownership and errors.

services.name: Context lifecycle
services.description: Create/destroy and activate/deactivate contexts; redraw when needed. A context describes an assigned display region, which may be the full Aurelia screen.

services.name: Timing
services.description: System timing and keyboard-repeat services replace CPU-speed-dependent loops.

specification.state_model: Per-application context state; no accidental shared cursor, selection or editing globals. Aurelia remains single-foreground; Artemis may manage multiple isolated application contexts.
compatibility_rules: Keep the same API behavior across Aurelia, Aurelia+ and Artemis.
Do not assume display stride, video RAM address, last column or direct peripheral registers.
Legacy CP/M console behavior is preserved; Logix-aware interfaces use the documented editing conventions.
Artemis implementation mediates process access to shared clipboard and display services.
